links.outcome: ChatGPT answer accuracy across low, moderate, and high language proficiency question formulations
links.effect: High-proficiency questions gave a higher share of accurate responses; other proficiency levels yielded mixed/incomplete or inaccurate answers. Overall accurate: 40.4% (3.5) and 56.3% (4.1 mini).
links.quote: While high proficiency demonstrated a higher percentage of accurate responses, all other results were either mixed/incomplete, or inaccurate.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT models answering microbiology-related questions at varying prompt/proficiency levels; evaluates baseline LLM accuracy rather than a specific operational health deployment practice.
